topic: Improving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for question answering

selected_papers.title: ChunkRank: Relevance-Weighted Passage Selection for RAG
selected_papers.abstract: We propose ChunkRank, a lightweight reranking step that scores retrieved passages by relevance to the query before they are shown to a generation model. On two short-context QA benchmarks, ChunkRank improves answer accuracy over a standard top-k retrieval baseline, with a small added latency cost from the reranking step. All experiments use single-hop, English-language questions.
